verdict.rationale: Quo ships a built-in AI agent, Sona, that answers calls when the team can't, captures details and hands off conversations. That is a narrow form of delegating a task to an in-product AI. The Claude/ChatGPT connectors and MCP server are external agents, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant users can instruct to perform arbitrary tasks, documentation of Sona's configurability and scope of delegable work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
